CREATE TABLE tableA(
    ID           int,
    RunYearMonth int
  )

CREATE TABLE tableB (
    ID           int,
    RunYearMonth int
  )

SELECT *
   FROM (
        SELECT *
        FROM tableA
        WHERE RunYearMonth = 202004
    ) AS A
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM tableB
        WHERE RunYearMonth = 202004
    ) AS B
    ON A.ID = B.ID
    AND A.RunYearMonth = B.RunYearMonth
